execution_rules.signal: PR459 unchanged: prior six completed continuous positive-volume M5; breach >=1 dated tick and completed-bar close >=1 tick back inside; ambiguous both-side invalid, same-direction 30-min dedup. Historical CNY tick and sessions unchanged.
execution_rules.admission: At prescribed timestamp use EXACT observed M5 Open, historical price tick, previously frozen reclaim, initial risk>=4 ticks. Do not use ANY future target-bar High/Low/Close/Volume to decide admission. Target bar Volume may be reported after close only as data-availability evidence, not Open-time eligibility filter.
execution_rules.fast0_timing: Signal candle source start t is finished at t+5, and the subsequent M5 candle opens at t+5. This hypothetical simultaneous calculation/quote/execution is an optimistic upper bound with no proven network/exchange latency; do not call it LIVE causal-valid or actual fill. Only use signal completed OHLCV, never next candle contents to make the decision.
execution_rules.fast5_timing: First model M5 Open STRICTLY LATER than end t+5 of signal candle: at t+10. No arbitrary 10/15-minute post-close wait.
execution_rules.gaps: Exact missing or 0-volume target evidence may be discovered on replay after target; preserve UNKNOWN_POSSIBLE_FILL, block later entries as in parent freeze; no assumption of precise broker acknowledgements. Missing held M5 path -> UNKNOWN gross/net/exit until modeled emergency close, and no annual profitability PASS.
execution_rules.stop: Freeze stop one dated tick beyond rejection candle extreme, unchanged throughout; protective stop resident on entry candle, adverse worse Open gap, STOP_FIRST for same-bar Stop/Take.
execution_rules.take: Freeze planned FULL-NET C1 3R: if s=entry to Stop distance and t=historically dated tick, favorable gross Take distance d=3*s+8*t (outward price rounding); no 2R in this rerun. No entry-bar TP and subsequent TP only with one full tick penetration. Maintain all predeclared conditional model limits.
execution_rules.other_exits: Copy original PR460 failed-reclaim invalidation, maximum hold 120min, flat-before-session/end, loss protection and UNKNOWN intent rules, except translate historical delay-dependent decision timestamps deterministically to FAST0/FAST5 without impossible retroactive orders. No extra indicators or changing policy for PF.
execution_rules.time_cutoff: For each window B, ensure exit request and earliest conditional Open/ack by B-10. No lunch/overnight carry. If impossible, UNKNOWN and safety violation, not a fabricated market close. Recompute timing mechanically from FAST0/FAST5, not by choosing a profitable earlier cutoff.
execution_rules.cost: C1 one dated tick each side; C2 replaces C1 with two dated ticks each side on identical fills/exits; 3R Take based on C1 only; no FINAM broker fees added, no RUB portfolio P&L claims without full contract specs.
execution_rules.entry_occupancy: One modeled position per instrument; EXIT-before-ENTRY and busy rejection; no overlap inflated as portfolio trade count.
execution_rules.reporting: 8 fast instrument/scenario runs with C1 primary and C2 identical-fill stress; 12 months all instruments with pre-inception NO_COVERAGE, no-trade and UNKNOWN distinct; only complete proof permits full annual Net/PF/DD, otherwise null and separate CLOSED_ONLY diagnostics.
execution_rules.verification: Independent replay-oracle for signals/entry/exits, edge clock tests FAST0/FAST5 and absence of future-bar input at entry, source byte prefix 2023 verified, original preflight/frozen files unchanged and TradingSystemLab protected Git tree SHA identical to main. No 2024 WF or 2025+ TRUE OOS reads.
execution_rules.status_policy: FAST0 optimistic modeled result NEVER accepted as live-ready or proven execution. FAST5 stricter replay separately assessed. At user-requested pace run the tests and report raw numbers BEFORE diagnosing losses or revising additional parameters. Do not advance Stage3, promote strategy, claim economic PASS from a positive closed-only cohort, or auto-merge.
